title: Converge Learn-it Atlas on one learning journey
purpose: Implement the smallest post-Human-Replay R14 correction justified by direct learner observation on the final R13 candidate: keep every objective reservoir visibly identifiable even when no evidence exists, bind the pre-session objective frame to the exact first objective of the frozen plan for the selected duration, and reuse the same macroscopic objective map in the completed-session summary to show what the session worked and which learner-facing evidence states actually changed. This is a projection-only correction: planner, recommendation ranking, evidence states, scoring, memory, storage, contracts, import semantics and authored kits remain unchanged.
invariants: Atlas learning actions from Today and Library continue to enter the same existing Atlas planner/session engine.
Only a context accepted by the existing Atlas claim authority may be presented as an Atlas learning journey; unsupported kits remain handled outside that journey.
An active Atlas activity owns the learner surface: course-level progress and recommendation chrome must not remain above the question.

When all objectives are already independently validated and not yet due for reconfirmation, presentation may suppress an immediate session action but must not change recommendation, evidence, memory or planner semantics.
The 5/15/30 duration policy and frozen planner construction are unchanged whenever a session is available.
Canonical evidence states, transitions, scoring, projection, learning-event semantics, history and resume state are unchanged.
learnit.kit.v2, authoring payloads, claim authority, accepted claim set and import semantics are unchanged.
No synthetic progress percentage or new learner state is introduced.
The objective framed before a new session is derived from plan.payload.items[0].objectiveRef for the currently selected duration, not from a second recommendation heuristic.

Completed-session delta highlighting is presentation-only and is computed from the pre-session learner-facing states plus the objectives present in the frozen plan; it is never persisted as a new progress model.
requiredEvidence: PR #354 exact R14 parent is 76fb8b6724d2fbcb7998b8eab92b8f2448ea8a6b before mutation.
Static and regression evidence proves compatibleAtlasCourse requires claimAuthority.contextAccepted(context).
Every authored course objective remains represented by one visible vertical reservoir when all objectives are not-started; zero evidence means zero fill, not a missing objective shell.
For the canonical Nombres Complexes Atlas kit, selecting a duration exposes a planned first objective and the framed reservoir has exactly that objective identity.
Starting the session after that preview renders a question whose Objectif label matches the previously framed reservoir; the same causal check is repeated after completion and return to Today.

The completed-session summary shows the full course objective map, including untouched objectives, and marks objectives included in the frozen plan separately from objectives whose learner-facing evidence state actually changed.
The summary delta introduces no percentage, persisted flag, evidence transition or planner mutation.
The previously used neutral qualification kit cannot masquerade as a fully qualified Atlas validation journey merely because it contains estimatedMinutes and claim-shaped fields.
The existing claim-authority-qualified Atlas content remains eligible for the Atlas surface.
While data-atlas-session-active=true, the enclosing course-row main/progress chrome is hidden and the active question surface remains focused.
Library objective segments expose the objective label and learner-facing state on hover through native title text.

When every ranked objective is validated-recently, its memory dueAt is in the future and the fallback recommendation would only repeat practice, Today and Library expose an 'À jour pour aujourd’hui' rest state with the next useful date instead of another immediate session control.
The atlas.memory-policy.v1 intervals remain exactly 1, 3, 7 and 21 days.
Existing Atlas core, learning, experience, integration and UX-clarity suites remain green.
The deterministic source manifest is rebound to all changed source/test files.
Exact-head PR CI passes before a new Human Replay is published.
adversarialTests: Do not broaden runtime claim authority or accept arbitrary authored claims in this UX patch.
Do not change atlas_memory.js intervals or manipulate time to make the replay reach acquisition faster.
Do not replace the rest-state presentation with a new evidence state or persisted flag.
Do not suppress active-session progress by hiding the question, feedback or answer controls.
Do not add a synthetic percentage or infer progress beyond existing evidence states.
Do not make the pre-session frame depend on label text once a concrete frozen plan objective identity exists.
Do not call an objective 'progressed' merely because it was included in the session; worked and state-changed must remain distinct visual facts.
Do not modify authoring kits, contracts, storage, scoring, projection, planner or import semantics.
Do not create a new QA programme or declare learner usability PASS from machine evidence.
nonGoals: Changing learnit.kit.v2 or any EPF/authoring kit payload.
Expanding the frozen accepted Atlas claim set to the neutral Human Replay fixture.
Changing Atlas memory spacing, planner duration policy, recommendation semantics, evidence states or scoring.
Creating persistent chapter, group, phase, parent-child hierarchy or a new progress metric.
Adding manual objective selection, favorites, an override algorithm or a new learning mode.
Creating a new runtime, backend, dashboard or contradictory-QA chain.
independentReview: The R13 screenshot after local reset is treated as direct product evidence: the second zero-fill objective exists in the DOM but is visually too weak compared with the outlined priority objective, so the shell contrast is corrected without inventing fill.

The R13 pre-session frame was inferred from learner copy while the actual question comes from the frozen plan; R14 removes that split-brain by binding the frame to the first planned objective identity.
The learner's request for a macro post-session view is implemented by reusing the existing objective-state map and distinguishing 'worked' from 'state changed'; no synthetic gain score is introduced.
Library presentation is intentionally preserved because the learner reported it as useful.
No learner usability PASS is owned by this implementation stream; the corrected candidate returns to Human Replay after exact-head machine qualification.
rollback: Revert the bounded R14 commits or reset PR #354 to exact R13 head 76fb8b6724d2fbcb7998b8eab92b8f2448ea8a6b. No persisted state, contract, kit, claim-authority, planner or memory-policy schema is changed.
